text:
leo: Hit a customer bug: double create when retry + auth refresh + idempotency header auto-generated. Repro: async POST -> 401 (token) -> auth refresh -> retry -> server saw different X-Idempotency-Key. Seen twice in prod.

ana: That matches a race we discussed. Our retry flow re-runs header factories, so ephemeral headers (x-idempotency) get regenerated. Also streaming bodies can't be rewound so retries sometimes re-read files and look like new requests.

mike: Proposal: capture original_headers at first attempt and reuse on retries unless opt-in allow_header_refresh=True. Merge only refreshed Authorization into preserved headers. Add RetryOptions.pin_headers_on_retry default true.

elaine: For streaming bodies add RewindableBody protocol with rewind()/reset() so retry can call it. If body isn't rewindable, fail fast and return an error asking caller to provide rewindable body. Add docs example with RewindableFile wrapper.

leo: Backoff: switch default from plain exponential to decorrelated jitter to avoid thundering retries during 5xx storms. Config fields: base, cap, jitter_factor.

mike: Typing: split `request()` vs `stream()` APIs. Current overloads confuse mypy. Consider Response[T] generic and explicit stream method returning AsyncIterator[bytes]. Update stubs.

ana: Tests: tests/test_retry_idempotency.py param sync/async and streaming/buffered. Simulate 401 then 503 then 201 and assert exactly one create with same idempotency key. Unit test header factory not re-run.

leo: I'll open a PR with the header pin + backoff change and note possible behavioral changes in changelog. @ci-bot please create issue and run unit tests.

ci-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/3333 and queued CI.

mike: Assign owners: mike -> retry impl, elaine -> typing + docs, ana -> rewindable body + tests. We'll add PR checklist item to flag non-deterministic header factories.

leo: Thanks. Will follow up with PR link shortly.
